value.rationale: Q4 is the canonical 16-state cyclic Gray-code search space, and a single alternating cycle is a natural local update. Square-only moves freeze 240 configurations, while hexagon-only moves connect the entire space; the exact minimal move length and diameter six matter to accessibility and local-update sampling. Sharp all-source distance census is a motivated finite invariant, not simply recomputation of the known number 1344 or a routine relabeling. A broader dimension-independent theorem is neither required nor claimed.
